summary: Military aircraft high-energy manoeuvres within 5 nautical miles of Hunderthwaite, surface to 5,000 feet, at speeds up to 450 knots.
text:
AIR EXER. 1 MIL ACFT WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES IN
SUPPORT OF GROUND TROOPS WI 5NM RADIUS OF 543546N 0020335W
(HUNDERTHWAITE). ACFT MAY OPERATE AT SPEEDS OF UP TO 450 KNOTS
IAS AND MAY BE UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR FURTHER INFO AIC
Y007/2023 REFERS. OPS CTC ON CH127.185 OR 277.350MHZ. FOR INFO
07517 258611. AR-2026-9972/02.
